events.text: Root cause: placement ray (paintGroundHitAt -> map_paint.groundHit -> heightAt) marched the fine 241-grid brush field, but the rendered terrain is the 121-grid ABS-MAX floor mirror, up to ~0.5m higher on sculpted ground. The 5cm floor plate buried inside the visible hill; 3m walls poked through. Fixed by marching the rendered mirror surface (paintGroundY) in the pick ray. Needs host rebuild to verify.

resolution: Floor placed on raised ground was invisible while walls showed. Diagnosed a see-it-vs-sample-it split: the placement/brush pick ray intersected heightAt's fine 241-grid brush field while the terrain mesh + collider render the 121-grid abs-max floor mirror, which sits up to ~0.5m above it on sculpted ground — so the 5cm floor plate landed buried inside the visible hill while a 3m wall still poked through (the same class as the req_2704 drowned grass, which already had the mirror sampler). Fix: engine.zig groundHit generalized to surfaceHit over any height surface; world_loader's paintGroundHitAt now marches a RenderFloorSurface that bilinearly samples the per-chunk mirror via paintGroundY/paintSlotFloorFor, so placement, ghost, brush beam and hover readout all land on the drawn surface. Map engine unit tests pass; needs a host rebuild (Zig change) to see in the editor.
